Compile a Production Multi-Service docker-compose.yml

Source: R/compile_compose.R
compile_compose.Rd

Generates a validated, security-hardened docker-compose.yml stack tailored to the scanned R project. For Shiny applications, compiles a multi-service stack with the primary app service, an async background worker service, and a pinned reverse proxy (caddy:2.8.4-alpine), complete with health checks, resource limits, no-new-privileges, read-only data mounts, named output volumes, and an isolated bridge network. For analysis or Quarto projects, compiles a clean reproducible execution service.

Usage

compile_compose(
  scan,
  output = NULL,
  service_name = NULL,
  image_tag = "0.1.0",
  dockerfile = "Dockerfile",
  include_worker = NULL,
  include_proxy = NULL,
  proxy_image = "caddy:2.8.4-alpine",
  port = 3838L,
  proxy_port = 8080L,
  memory_limit = "2G",
  cpus = "2.0",
  env_vars = list(),
  volumes = NULL,
  restart_policy = NULL,
  platform = NULL
)

Arguments

scan

An rcapsule_scan object from scan_project() or a path to a project directory.

output

Optional file path to write docker-compose.yml. If NULL, returns the compiled spec in memory.

service_name

Optional primary service name (defaults to "app" for Shiny projects, or a sanitized slug of scan$project_name).

image_tag

Pinned local image tag for the built service (defaults to "0.1.0"). Must not be "latest".

dockerfile

Path to the Dockerfile relative to build context. Defaults to "Dockerfile".

include_worker

Logical or NULL. If NULL, automatically enables a background worker service for Shiny projects (especially when async packages or worker.R are detected).

include_proxy

Logical or NULL. If NULL, automatically enables a pinned reverse proxy service (caddy:2.8.4-alpine) for Shiny projects.

proxy_image

Pinned reverse proxy container image. Defaults to "caddy:2.8.4-alpine".

port

Internal application port (default 3838L for Shiny).

proxy_port

Host port mapped to the reverse proxy (default 8080L).

memory_limit

Memory limit per service (e.g., "2G").

cpus

CPU quota per service as character or numeric (e.g., "2.0").

env_vars

Named list or character vector of extra environment variables (avoid hardcoding secrets; use ${ENV_VAR} interpolation).

volumes

Optional character vector of extra volume mounts.

restart_policy

Docker restart policy for long-running services. Defaults to "unless-stopped" for Shiny and "no" for batch analyses.

platform

Optional target container platform ("linux/amd64", "linux/arm64", or NULL for host default) applied to built services.

Value

An S3 object of class c("rcapsule_compose", "rcapsule_spec") with fields content, lines, config (parsed list), services, platform, project_type, path, and scan.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_compose_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines(c("library(shiny)", "shinyApp(fluidPage('Hi'), function(i, o) {})"),
           file.path(tmp, "app.R"))
comp <- compile_compose(tmp)
names(comp$config$services)
#> [1] "app"    "worker" "proxy" 
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
